description: Create (or with updateEnabled update) a Brevo contact (POST /contacts). Required: email or attributes.SMS / ext_id. Optional: attributes (e.g. { FIRSTNAME, LASTNAME, SMS }), listIds (array of numbers), updateEnabled (default true), emailBlacklisted, smsBlacklisted. Only add people who consented to marketing.

attributes.description: Contact attributes, e.g. { FIRSTNAME, LASTNAME, SMS }

emailBlacklisted.description: Block the contact from receiving e-mails

smsBlacklisted.description: Block the contact from receiving SMS

updateEnabled.description: Update the contact if it already exists (default true)

name: create_brevo_contact
